title: MelvinCobbleTech(MCT)
description: This is a custom-built modpack based on Cobblemon x Create, with more tech mods and a selection of additional Cobblemon mods included.
body:
MelvinCobbleTech

MelvinCobbleTech is a heavily expanded modpack built for a long-term multiplayer experience focused on Pokémon, automation, technology, exploration, and dimensional progression.

🌟 What is MelvinCobbleTech?

MelvinCobbleTech combines Pokémon adventure, industrial automation, advanced technology, exploration, and creativity into one cohesive multiplayer experience.

Catch Pokémon, build factories, automate everything, explore new dimensions, and create your own world. Whether you prefer battling, breeding, engineering, building, or adventuring, MelvinCobbleTech offers hundreds of hours of progression and discovery.

The pack combines the world of Pokémon with large-scale factories, advanced storage systems, immersive exploration, and powerful endgame technology.
